messages:
luis (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — dropping an open thread for any remaining Qs on hybrid policy, upcoming offsites, travel reimbursements, and HQ desk booking. We'll try to answer within the day.

maya (Product): Thanks! Two quick ones: 1) Are team 'core in-office days' mandatory or just guidance? 2) For product offsite travel, do we get pre-approved travel booking or should we wait for an invite?

luis (People Ops): Great q's — short answers: 1) Guidance + team-level agreements. Leadership recommended 2 on-site days/week as a baseline, but teams set their own core days by consensus. If a role needs more in-person collaboration we'll flag it during onboarding. 2) Wait for the offsite invite — that thread will contain approved dates, travel window, and booking instructions.

aziz (Eng): Clarify the "2 days/week" baseline — is that enforced for Dedicated teams with on-call rotations? We have a couple of folks in EU timezones.

people-ops-bot: Note posted: Office attendance policy (v2) updated: https://redwood.company/policies/office-attendance (digest sent to new-hires).

luis (People Ops): Aziz — it's not a hard enforcement. For teams that need coverage across timezones, work with your manager to set expectations. If in-person is required for a particular meeting/offsite you'll be notified in advance and travel will be supported where appropriate.

claire (Office Ops): On desk booking — we recommend hot-desking for occasional visitors. If you need a reservable quiet room for multi-day focused work, DM me and we can reserve a team hoteling block at HQ (max 2 weeks). Also, we now have a dedicated nursing room near the 3rd floor conference cluster.

maya (Product): Thanks Claire — how does the desk/office pass work for visitors from partners/vendors? Do they need a badge request?

claire (Office Ops): Yes — vendors/partners need a sponsor (employee) to submit a badge request 72h before arrival. Use the #vendors channel for quick intake OR the badge portal: https://badges.redwood.company.

devon (Finance): Expense/reporting note — for offsites/travel: use expense code OFFSITE-2026 in Concur. Per diem caps: $75/day domestic, $150/day international. Hotels should be booked on the company card when possible (bookings will be posted to your travel request). Receipts required for >$25 items.

maya (Product): Perfect, thanks. Also, if we stay one extra personal day after the offsite, do we get reimbursed for the work portion of travel?

luis (People Ops): Good question. Standard policy: only business portion is reimbursable. If you extend for personal reasons, reimbursements cover the original return date. If you need exceptions (e.g., cheaper return flights combined with personal days), tag Finance and People Ops in your travel request and we'll review case-by-case.

aziz (Eng): Offsite childcare support? We have a couple of parents in Eng asking if Redwood covers emergency childcare when travel overlaps with school/preschool days.

sophia (CEO): We want to make offsites inclusive. We don't have a universal childcare stipend yet, but we will reimburse reasonable emergency childcare costs for company-required travel. Leave policy for caregiving still applies — please reach out to People Ops for a fast-tracked review on a per-case basis. We're also exploring a childcare pilot for the next big offsite.

maya (Product): Appreciated, thanks @sophia.

luis (People Ops): Final logistics note: next all-company offsite (tentative) Sept 20–23, RSVP window opens July 1. Team leads, please confirm headcounts by July 10. We'll post the official invite and pre-approved travel window in #all-hands and email.

aziz (Eng): One last ops nit: will we have a shared GitHub repo for offsite agendas/materials? Easier than chasing emails.

luis (People Ops): Yes — we'll create a shared `redwood-offsites/2026-fall` repo and grant read/write to attendees. Claire will attach the location map and hotel logistics in that repo.

claire (Office Ops): Putting a note here — volunteers needed for on-site logistics team (setup, A/V liaisons). If you can help, react to this thread with :raised_hands: or DM me.

maya (Product): :raised_hands: happy to help on A/V liaisons for product sessions.

devon (Finance): If you haven't done travel training, complete the 10-min module in Workday — it unlocks booking on the company card.

luis (People Ops): Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate answers and post a short FAQ in #people-ops by EOD. If anyone needs 1:1 clarification, ping me or Claire. :thumbsup:
